title: ggml : fix time overflow in ggml_time_us
body:
## Overview

<!-- Describe what this PR does and why. Be concise but complete -->

Currently, long-running `llama-server` processes will automatically crash after ~10.5 days because they hit an overflow in `ggml_time_us`. At that point, the intermediate `(t.QuadPart-timer_start) * 1000000` turns negative, hitting:

```
tools/server/server-common.h:418: GGML_ASSERT(t_start > 0) failed
```

This PR resolves that by removing the need for that intermediate, and preserves the accuracy. The same crash would now occur around `10.5 days * 1000000 ~ 30,000 years`. Hopefully no process lasts that long!

## Additional Information

I have also implemented the same in `ggml_time_ms` for uniformity, though the overflow there will never trigger before `ggml_time_us`.
